name: youtube-studio-mcp
description: YouTube MCP server: bulk video uploads, metadata, playlists, captions, comments, live streams and analytics.

interface.shortDescription: Upload and manage YouTube videos from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect your YouTube channel with Google OAuth so Codex can bulk-upload videos, edit titles, descriptions and tags, manage playlists, captions, comments and live streams, and read YouTube Analytics through a local MCP server.
